nodes.label: Three-Tier Luxury Beauty Marketplace Architecture
nodes.rationale: Integrates At-Home Beauty Services, Salons & Parlours Discovery, and The Beauty Store across 5 user personas on a unified FastAPI backend and single PostgreSQL database to keep authentication, ledgers, and state coordinated.

nodes.label: Vite 7 + Vanilla JS ES2022 SPA Frontend Architecture
nodes.norm_label: vite 7 + vanilla js es2022 spa frontend architecture
nodes.rationale: Avoids frontend framework lock-in while delivering 60fps luxury editorial rendering using Cormorant Garamond and Manrope typography, single stylesheet design tokens, document-level event delegation, and esc() XSS sanitization.

nodes.label: Cycle-Free Acyclic Directed Graph Backend Layering
nodes.norm_label: cycle-free acyclic directed graph backend layering
nodes.rationale: Backend imports flow strictly downward (main.py -> api/v1/ -> api/deps.py -> core/ & models/ & schemas/) with 0 circular import cycles, isolating domain models via FKs and SQLAlchemy relationships.
